stop_reason: Sacrifice time post-SCI is completely confounded with exercise: every SWIM and SWW animal was collected at 13.5 weeks and every CONT SCI animal at 11.5 weeks (GEO characteristics time; paper S2.3.p1, TAB1). No unexercised contused group exists at 13.5 weeks and no exercised group at 11.5 weeks, so both planned contrasts estimate exercise plus two extra weeks of chronic SCI, tiny-cage restriction and age, and the two cannot be separated in any model. The time-matched alternative (SWIM vs SWW) compares exercise modalities, not exercise versus no exercise. Suitability report: covariance fail, time nested with grp (GSE129694/suitability/suitability.md).
